D: A group of damaged antiheroes is tricked into a trap and ends up working together.
P: Serve the mains when the misfit team finally sits down together.
S: Nut, apricot and chocolate trail mix
Roasted almonds and cashews, dried apricot and chocolate chips
Almonds and cashews roasted at 180C for 10 minutes, mixed with dried apricots and dark chocolate chips, portioned into paper bags.
Cucumber spears pickled in vinegar with dill and garlic
Cucumbers pickled overnight with dill, garlic and vinegar, served with rye bread and salted butter.
the team breaking out of the vault

Beef patties smashed thin on a hot grill, cheddar melted on, tucked into slider buns with pickles and tomato sauce. Roll 500g beef mince into 12 balls. Smash each flat onto a smoking hot greased flat plate, season and cook 2 minutes until a dark crust forms. Flip, top with a quarter slice of cheddar and cook 1 minute more. Toast 12 slider buns cut side down. Mix 3 tbsp mayo with 1 tbsp tomato sauce and 1 tbsp mustard. Build with sauce, a patty, sliced dill pickle and a few thin onion rings.
M: Sliced rump, mushrooms, paprika and sour cream sauce

Beef strips seared, mushrooms and onion cooked down with paprika, finished with sour cream, over buttered noodles. Sear 600g thinly sliced rump in batches and set aside. Cook a sliced onion and 300g mushrooms until golden, add a spoon of sweet paprika, then stir in 300ml sour cream and return the beef. Warm through without boiling and serve over buttered egg noodles.

Chicken thighs marinated in lemon, garlic and shawarma spices, charred and sliced into flatbread with lettuce, tomato, pickles and garlic sauce. Marinate 800g chicken thigh for 1 hour with the juice of 1 lemon, 3 crushed garlic cloves, 2 tsp cumin, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp cinnamon and 3 tbsp olive oil. Grill on high heat 5 minutes a side until charred, rest and slice. Mix 150g Greek yoghurt with 1 crushed garlic clove, lemon juice and salt for the sauce. Warm 4 large flatbreads and fill with lettuce, tomato, pickled turnip or dill pickles, chicken and sauce. Roll tightly in foil.
W: Buttery cookies with ground black sesame

Butter cookies made with ground black sesame, baked at 170C for 12 minutes, half dipped in white chocolate. Grind 50g black sesame seeds fine. Beat 150g butter with 80g sugar, add 200g flour and the sesame and roll into a log. Chill 30 minutes, slice into 20 rounds and bake at 170C for 12 minutes. Dip half of each in 100g melted white chocolate.
K: Black tea sweetened with cherry jam, chilled

Strong black tea chilled and stirred with cherry jam, lemon and vodka, topped with soda over ice. Leave out the vodka for a softer one. Steep 4 black tea bags in 600ml boiling water for 5 minutes, remove the bags and stir in 4 tbsp cherry jam until dissolved. Chill well, then strain out any fruit. Mix with the juice of 1 lemon and 160ml vodka. Fill 4 glasses with ice, pour in the tea and top each with a splash of soda water. Garnish with a lemon slice and a few fresh or frozen cherries.
